lines: Jesus, my Lord, You bought me with Your blood. This body is Yours.

I train because I’m charged to. I train to be Your disciple, a protector of my family, and a warrior ready to stand against the devil’s schemes every day. I put on Your armor, and I will not be caught unprepared.
Burn away my weakness, my excuses, and my pride. When I want to quit, remind me what You endured for me.
Keep me alert, firm in the faith, courageous, and strong, and let all I do be done in love.
Forge me today, Lord. Then send me.
